comments.body:
![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The `useI18n` composable is imported and the `t` function is declared, but they are not used within the `<script setup>` block. The template has access to the `$t` function globally for translations, making these lines redundant. Removing them will improve code clarity and reduce clutter.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The icon `i-solar:chat-square-like-bold-duotone` is applied using a `class` attribute. However, elsewhere in this file, icons from the same set are consistently applied as direct attributes (e.g., `<div i-solar:chat-square-like-bold-duotone ... />`). To maintain a consistent coding style across the component, it would be better to use the attribute form here as well.

```
              <div i-solar:chat-square-like-bold-duotone />
```

This line contains trailing whitespace after the closing parenthesis. Please remove the trailing spaces to maintain code cleanliness.
```suggestion
                高通滤波器的频率设置，用于抑制低频噪声（如次低频噪声）
```
